about.title: About
paragraphs: I have spent nearly 5 years running critical production infrastructure: monitoring, L2/L3 incident diagnosis, virtual machine provisioning and Linux and Windows administration. I have worked with French, Canadian and international clients.

I specialise in observability and automation. I build monitoring and dashboards with Zabbix, Grafana and Prometheus, and automate their configuration through GitOps, with GitLab CI/CD and NetBox as the source of truth. With a Master’s in Cybersecurity, I bring security into operations: system hardening, access management and alert monitoring.
I am looking for a role focused on observability and automation, in Morocco, France or remote. Arabic is my native language, and I work in French and English every day.

bullets: Monitoring of more than 1,200 Linux and Windows systems with Zabbix, Grafana and Prometheus
Zabbix and Grafana integration: dashboards and mapping of physical data centres
GitOps automation of a critical Zabbix environment through GitLab, with NetBox as the source of truth
Secure load balancing with Traefik (reverse proxy, CDN, WAF)
Virtual machine provisioning on AWS, Proxmox and VMware; L2/L3 incident diagnosis
Deployment and administration of Centreon, Eye of Network and MOM (internal client tooling) for French and international clients
Defined monitoring indicators and handled alerts and incidents within SLAs
Python automation scripts replacing manual tasks
Preventive and corrective maintenance ahead of version upgrades
Linux and Windows administration, Active Directory, VMware and Hyper-V
Main technical contact for more than 120 Canadian institutional clients
Security alert monitoring (SentinelOne, Kaspersky, Proofpoint) and redesign of escalation procedures

pro.title: Multi-region hybrid private cloud
pro.context: Secure private cloud across 3 regions in high availability: more than 30 clustered Proxmox nodes, switches, firewalls and internal applications.
did: End-to-end monitoring of a strictly segmented environment.

pro.title: Wazuh SIEM monitoring & CIS compliance
pro.context: Wazuh SIEM platform and CIS compliance audits across a large workload estate.
did: Centralised monitoring of Wazuh components through the Zabbix API.
Contributed, together with the Ansible team, to automating CIS audits and remediation across more than 300 workloads, cutting turnaround from several days to a few hours.

perso.title: Automated video production pipeline
perso.context: End-to-end automated system that turns comics into narrated videos, all the way to YouTube publication. More than 200 episodes processed.
did: Six chained stages: image extraction, description by vision models, script generation, text-to-speech, video assembly and YouTube publication (API v3, OAuth).
Parallel pipeline architecture, automatic recovery after failures, and failover between several AI providers (local GPU and cloud gateway).
FastAPI operations web interface: queues, real-time tracking and GPU monitoring.
perso.method: I designed and directed the system: detailed specifications, review of every change as a GitHub pull request (40+ PRs), testing on real data and diagnosing failures from logs. Development itself was AI-assisted.

perso.title: Home lab & tooling
perso.context: Personal infrastructure for hosting AI models and services, reachable remotely without exposure to the internet.
did: Local AI models on GPU and a multi-provider gateway.
Docker services and zero-trust remote access through Twingate, without exposure to the internet.
CLI utility that removes silences from videos (ffmpeg).
Windows control panel with real-time monitoring.

diagram.title: Video pipeline architecture
diagram.desc: Six stages in sequence: ingestion, vision model, script generation, text-to-speech, video assembly, publication. AI stages fail over between a local GPU and a cloud gateway.
diagram.legend: AI: local GPU or cloud gateway, with automatic failover. Stages run in parallel and resume after failures.
